option_relations.rationale: Developmental delay is a symptom/finding, not a specific disease, and is not directly related to Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia.

RASA1-related disorders (Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation Syndrome) are distinct genetic conditions from Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia, although both involve vascular malformations.
Vascular malformation of the nose is a localized finding, not a systemic disease like Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia.
Concurrent Microcephaly-capillary malformation syndrome (MIC-CAP) and Mowat-Wilson syndrome (MWS) are distinct genetic syndromes and are not related to Hereditary Hemorrhagic Telangiectasia.
